about: The most the white rabbit's scene may reach at any checkpoint of make perf (scripts/perf.cjs), per profile.
Set on 2026-11-09 from v0.31.0's counts with about 10% headroom, rounded up. The desktop's frame calls, textures, and programs
also allow for bloom (13 draws, its render targets, and its shaders), which a real GPU keeps on but the software-rendered run drops.
Raise a number only on purpose, in the same change as what needs it, and rerun PERF_REPORT=docs/perf-report.md make perf.
